main_text.p: 7. Mare est hieroglyphicum doctrinæ cœlestis, Apoc. 4. & 15. vbi fit mentio maris vitrei.
8. Terra est mysticum hieroglyphicum ecclesiæ per Christum renouatæ,& olim glorificandæ,Esa.66.vers.22. & c.65.v.17. 5

9. Emeteoris, nubes sunt hieroglyphica nota doctorum, & quidem ita, vt fœcundæ repræsentent bonos doctores,infœcundæ malos, Prou.25.v.14. Deut.32.v.2. Hebr.12. v.1. pluuia est imago vesbi Dei,eiusque doctrinæ salutaris, Deut.32. v.2.Esa.55.v.10. 11.item hominis salutaria documenta & consilia dantis,Iob. 29. v. 23. inprimis doctorum euangelii. Mich.5.vers.7. item benedictionis, quam Deus nobis confert in Christo, Psal.72.v.6.7. Hose.6.v.3. pluuia impetuosa est imago calamitatis, Eccles.12.vers.2. Matth.7. v.26.27 ros est imago Christi,Hos.14.v.5: verbi Dei,&doctrinæ saluificæ, Deut.32.v.2: multitudinis fidelium in N. T.Ps.110.v.3. doctoru euangelii, Mich.5.v.7.2.Cor.2.ver.15. 1.Cor.3.v.6. donorum diuinitus collatorum, Psal.133.v.3. beneuolentiæ magistratus erga subditos, Prou.19.v.12. infelicitatis hominum impiorum, Hos.13.v.3. & pietatis hypocritarum, Hos.6.v.4. Ventus est hieroglyphicum Spiritus sancti, Iohan.3.v.8: sanctorum angelorum, Zach.6.v.5: publicarum calamitatum, Apoc.7.v.1. doctrinæ cœlestis, ibid. iudiciorum Dei horrendorum. Esa.41.v.16.c.57.v.17. Matth.7.v.27. Ezech.13.v.10.11. Iob.21.v.17. Psal.1.v.4. denique vanitatis, Iob.6.v.26.c.7.v.7.c.15.v.2. Hos.12.v.2.c.8. v.7. tonitru est imago verbi Dei, ac inprimis euangelii, cuius sonus totum terrarum orbem subito peruasit,&corda hominum perculit, vt ad Christum conuerterentur, Apoc.4 v.5.c.14.v.2. item præconum euangelii, Apoc.10.v.3. 10 15 20 25 30

4. Quam ob causam Iacobo & Iohanni, apostolis fratribus, Christus imposuit nomina Bonaerges, quod est, filii tonitrui, Marc.3.v.17. Est etiam imago comminationum diuinarum, Apoc.6. v.1. & magni consensus atque vehementis contentionis omnium electorum in laudando Deo, Apoc.19.v.6. 35

page.notes: The line numbers 5 to 35 in the right margin are printed line counts, shown as notes. The word "Ezech." and the letter forms "vesbi" and "ros" are as printed and may be doubtful. The mark "10." at the bottom right, before the catchword, may be a signature and was left out because I am not sure of it. The scan is slightly blurred at the right edge.
